description:
Search YouTube by keyword: videos, Shorts, channels and playlists with views, publish time, duration and channel. Optional type, popularity sort and upload-date filters.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: query (string), type (string), sort (string), upload_date (string, nullable), results_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean), results (array<object>).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Example: 10

query.description: Search keywords (max 200 characters). Example: "lofi hip hop"

sort.description: relevance or popularity (view_count is accepted as an alias). Default relevance. Example: "popularity"

type.description: Result type: all, video, shorts, channel or playlist. Default all. Example: "video"

upload_date.description: Only results uploaded within: today, week, month or year. Example: "week"

name: youtube_search
title: YouTube search
